layer_3_action.subject: A quiet, humid Late Jurassic lake surrounded by dense evergreen forest
features: Still, dark lake water with fine anaerobic silts on the floor
Dense thickets of Araucarian conifers and giant horsetails
Abundant Jurassic lacewings and dragonflies hovering over the margins
Fallen logs covered in thick, damp bryophyte mats
Subdued, moody lighting filtering through a thick forest canopy
layer_3_action.action: A sheltered, primeval forest scene. The environment is humid and still, perfect for the preservation of delicate soft tissues. The ground is a dark, loamy forest floor. No grass.

visuals.ground: Dark, carbonaceous mudstone and fine-grained brownish silts. Spongy mosses and fallen conifer needles. No grass.
visuals.water: Stagnant and dark; the surface is broken only by ripples from insects or small reptiles.
visuals.sky: Deep forest green canopy filter; the sky is barely visible as pale patches through the trees.

negative_prompt: grass, bright blue sky, flowers, ocean, desert, city, humans
